choose.when: SELECT t1.corp_gr AS corpGr , TO_CHAR(t1.tr_ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS trYmd , t1.fund_cd AS fundCd , t1.tr_co_cd AS trCoCd , t1.enc_acct_no AS encAcctNo , t1.stock_aek AS yeStockAek , t1.bond_aek AS yeBondAek , t1.fund_aek AS yeFundAek , t1.cash_aek AS cashAek , (t1.tot_aek + NVL(uh.mibae_aek, 0)) AS yeTotAek , (NVL(uh.stock_aek, 0) - NVL(uh.collateral, 0)) AS uhStockAek , NVL(uh.stock_gongmo, 0) AS uhStockGongmo , NVL(uh.bond_aek, 0) AS uhBondAek , NVL(uh.sj_aek, 0) AS uhSjAek , (NVL(uh.cash_aek, 0) - f_misubaed_aek(#{corpGr}, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), t1.fund_cd)) AS uhCashAek , uh.sun_jasan_aek AS uhNav , TO_CHAR(t1.conf_ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS confYmd , ia.fund_nm AS fundNm , TO_DECRYPTS(t1.enc_acct_no) AS acctNo , f_misubaed_aek(#{corpGr}, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), t1.fund_cd) AS misuBaedAek , f_mijigub_aek(#{corpGr}, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), t1.fund_cd) AS mijigubAek , f_gaek(#{corpGr}, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), t1.fund_cd) AS gaek , f_gsonik1(#{corpGr}, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), t1.fund_cd) AS gsonik FROM SHT0YE t1 , UZM0UH uh , SZM0IA ia WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.tr_ymd = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND uh.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND uh.ymd = t1.tr_ymd AND uh.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd ORDER BY t1.tr_co_cd ASC, ia.fund_nm ASC
choose.otherwise: SELECT t1.corp_gr AS corpGr , TO_CHAR(t1.tr_ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS trYmd , t1.fund_cd AS fundCd , t1.tr_co_cd AS trCoCd , t1.enc_acct_no AS encAcctNo , t1.stock_aek AS yeStockAek , t1.bond_aek AS yeBondAek , t1.cash_aek AS cashAek , t1.tot_aek AS yeTotAek , (NVL(uh.stock_aek, 0) - NVL(uh.collateral, 0)) AS uhStockAek , NVL(uh.stock_gongmo, 0) AS uhStockGongmo , NVL(uh.bond_aek, 0) AS uhBondAek , uh.sun_jasan_aek AS uhNav , TO_CHAR(t1.conf_ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS confYmd , ia.fund_nm AS fundNm , TO_DECRYPTS(t1.enc_acct_no) AS acctNo , f_misubaed_aek(#{corpGr}, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), t1.fund_cd) AS misuBaedAek , f_mijigub_aek(#{corpGr}, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), t1.fund_cd) AS mijigubAek , f_gaek(#{corpGr}, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), t1.fund_cd) AS gaek , f_gsonik1(#{corpGr}, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), t1.fund_cd) AS gsonik FROM SHT0YE t1 , UZM0UH uh , SZM0IA ia WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.tr_ymd = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND uh.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND uh.ymd = t1.tr_ymd AND uh.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd AND ia.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd ORDER BY t1.tr_co_cd ASC, ia.fund_nm ASC
